verdict.rationale: AFK's docs describe tasks as directed graphs where 'blocked nodes resume automatically when dependencies clear,' implying some workflow persistence and async waiting, but there is no explicit claim about surviving worker/platform restarts or crash recovery, nor evidence of durable execution infrastructure. missing for 10: explicit restart/crash-survival guarantees, evidence of durable state persistence across days-long waits, independent or technical corroboration of the execution engine's fault tolerance.
